title: In re Korean Southwest Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC unanimously accepted Korean Southwest Presbytery's responses, which the Presbytery had approved, as complying with its citation, and noted that those responses were forwarded to the Review of Presbytery Records Committee.
first_summary: The SJC accepted Korean Southwest Presbytery's responses to its citation and forwarded them to the Review of Presbytery Records Committee. No underlying merits or reasons are stated.
summary: The SJC accepted Korean Southwest Presbytery's responses, approved by the Presbytery, as complying with its citation. It forwarded them to the Review of Presbytery Records Committee. The sparse record identifies no underlying citation grounds, merits analysis, or separate opinion; the practical result was a finding of citation compliance and continued records review.
